# Approved release scope

This report consumes an explicit, checksum-bound approved release control. The
registry enables eight physical cohorts and nine evaluation entries: Kidney
condition and tissue are scored separately. Eight methods including the actual
stored NULL control contribute five equally weighted separation metrics (360
values). Missing required new results stop the report; historical manifests
remain available only through their separate strict historical readers.

No method, preprocessing or Pipeline 4 annotation is run here. Batch views use
configured source annotations. Primary NULL labels are preserved from their
bundles; Kidney tissue NULL uses its own recorded seed 124. Tissue groups
(45 generic kidney, 23 cortex, 12 medulla) are partly confounded with suspension:
the generic kidney samples are cells, while cortex/medulla samples are nuclei.
Both axes reuse the same features, distances and MDS coordinates; neither axis
is protected or used as a covariate during correction.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") setwd("..")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(funkyheatmap)
})
source("src/utils/load_all_functions.R")
source("src/utils/analysis_release.R")
source("src/utils/evaluation_scores.R")
source("src/utils/batch_effect_analysis.R")
view <- "batch_effect_uncorrected"
control <- read_batch_release_control(Sys.getenv("ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL"),
  Sys.getenv("ECODA_BATCH_RELEASE_CONTROL_MD5"), view)
datasets <- control$datasets
batch_datasets <- names(datasets)
selected_methods <- setdiff(batch_release_method_keys(view), "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL")
method_labels <- unname(method_label_map_main[selected_methods])
stopifnot(!anyNA(method_labels))
method_colors <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(method_labels), "Dark 3"), method_labels)
registry <- batch_candidate_registry(datasets, batch_datasets)
set.seed(42)
options(mc.cores = 1L)
parallel_cores <- 1L; n_permutations <- 999L; permanova_permutations <- 99L
# Complete finite-grid preflight precedes every figure and output write.
report <- score_batch_release(control)
stopifnot(nrow(report$scores) == 360L)
plot_root <- file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_uncorrected_final")
analysis_output_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", view, control$release_id)
```

# Five-metric scores and funkyheatmap

Biological MDS subtitles use the same scaled five-metric entry mean, including
NULL in the comparison ranges. Technical colourings show individual raw metrics
or an explicit unscorable status for constant axes.

Each metric is min-max scaled within dataset, view and evaluation axis. Constant
ranges receive neutral 0.5. Overall rankings are descending arithmetic means of
all five metrics and nine equally weighted evaluation entries. Kidney therefore
has two entries. Both Silhouette and already transformed LISI separation appear
in the right-hand metric summaries and separate per-metric plots.

```{r five-metric-report, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
write_batch_release_artifact(report, file.path(analysis_output_root, "evaluation_release.rds"))
write_batch_release_artifact(report$scores,
  file.path(analysis_output_root, "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_heatmap_scores.csv"), csv = TRUE)
plot_data <- report$scores
plot_data$method <- plot_data$method_key; plot_data$score <- plot_data$metric
dir.create(plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
build_funky_heatmap(plot_data, exec_times = NULL,
  filter_methods = batch_release_method_keys(view), method_recode = method_label_map_main,
  dataset_recode = setNames(batch_datasets, batch_datasets), score_set = evaluation_metrics(),
  output_file = "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_funkyheatmap.pdf", output_dir = plot_root,
  plot_width = 14, plot_height = 8, expected_grid = control$expected_grid)
for (metric in evaluation_metrics()) {
  rows <- plot_data[plot_data$metric == metric, ]
  rows$entry <- paste(rows$dataset, rows$evaluation_id, sep = " / ")
  plot <- ggplot(rows, aes(method_key, value, fill = method_key)) + geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(~entry, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = metric, title = "Raw separation metric; higher is better")
  ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0("batch_effect_uncorrected_final_", metric, ".pdf")), plot, width = 14, height = 9)
}
```

# Six-cohort heatmap excluding Kidney KPMP and Lung

This additional export retains the original uncorrected method pool, including
NULL. Dataset cells, metric means, overall means and row ranking are recomputed
from the six retained cohorts only. The original eight-cohort heatmap is preserved.

```{r six-cohort-heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
subset_datasets <- setdiff(batch_datasets, c("Kidney_KPMP_full", "Lung"))
subset_methods <- batch_release_method_keys(view)
subset_plot_data <- plot_data[plot_data$dataset %in% subset_datasets &
  plot_data$method_key %in% subset_methods, , drop = FALSE]
subset_expected_grid <- control$expected_grid[control$expected_grid$dataset %in% subset_datasets &
  control$expected_grid$method_key %in% subset_methods, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(length(subset_datasets) == 6L, nrow(subset_plot_data) == 240L)
build_funky_heatmap(subset_plot_data, exec_times = NULL,
  filter_methods = subset_methods, method_recode = method_label_map_main,
  dataset_recode = setNames(subset_datasets, subset_datasets), score_set = evaluation_metrics(),
  output_file = "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_funkyheatmap_without_Kidney_KPMP_full_and_Lung.pdf",
  output_dir = plot_root, plot_width = 14, plot_height = 8,
  expected_grid = subset_expected_grid)
```

# MDS and current-cohort confounding tables

Each cohort is loaded and released separately. Biological and technical
colourings share one MDS solution per method. The primary MDS filename remains
`<dataset>_mds.pdf`; Kidney additionally writes `_mds_evaluation_tissue.pdf`.

```{r batch-mds, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (dataset in batch_datasets) {
  result <- load_batch_release_dataset(control, dataset)
  panels <- plot_batch_release_mds(result, datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col, method_label_map_main[selected_methods])
  for (name in names(panels)) {
    suffix <- if (name == "biological") "" else paste0("_", name)
    ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_mds", suffix, ".pdf")), panels[[name]], width = 13, height = 12)
    if (name == "evaluation_tissue") ggsave(file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_mds_region.pdf")), panels[[name]], width = 13, height = 12)
  }
  for (axis in names(result$evaluations)) {
    stem <- if (axis == result$primary_evaluation) dataset else paste0(dataset, "_", axis)
    write_batch_biology_tables(result$metadata, stem, datasets[[dataset]]$evaluation_labels[[axis]],
      datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col, file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_bio_vs_batch"),
      file.path(analysis_output_root, "bio_vs_batch"), lane = control$release_id)
  }
  rm(result, panels)
}
```

# Covariate diagnostics

The established ANOSIM, univariate and joint PERMANOVA, decomposition and NMI
reports retain their definitions and filenames. These are separately labeled
covariate diagnostics; they do not replace the five-metric default ranking.

```{r plotting-helpers}
.metric_warning <- function(...) {
  pieces <- as.character(c(...))
  pieces <- pieces[!is.na(pieces) & nzchar(pieces)]
  paste(unique(pieces), collapse = "; ")
}

.metric_plot <- function(data, value_column, status_column, title, y_label, exclude_primary = FALSE) {
  if (exclude_primary) data <- data[!data$is_primary, , drop = FALSE]
  data <- data[data[[status_column]] == "ESTIMABLE" & is.finite(data[[value_column]]), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = paste0(title, "\nNo estimable candidate")))
  }
  data$method_label <- factor(data$method_label, levels = method_labels)
  data$candidate <- factor(data$candidate, levels = unique(data$candidate))
  data$candidate_class <- factor(
    data$candidate_class,
    levels = c(
      "biological_primary",
      "biological_secondary",
      "technical",
      "shared_biological_technical"
    )
  )
  ggplot(data, aes(x = candidate, y = .data[[value_column]], fill = method_label)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.82), width = 0.76) +
    facet_wrap(~candidate_class, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = y_label, fill = "Method") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

.blank_plot <- function(title, subtitle = NULL) {
  ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
}

.save_plot <- function(plot, path, width = 12, height = 7) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", device = "pdf")
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size <= 0) stop("empty plot output: ", path)
  invisible(path)
}



```

```{r batch-analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
metric_tables <- list(); joint_tables <- list(); decomposition_tables <- list(); nmi_tables <- list()
metric_index <- 0L; joint_index <- 0L; decomposition_index <- 0L; nmi_index <- 0L
for (dataset in batch_datasets) {
  dataset_result <- load_batch_release_dataset(control, dataset)
  ds_registry <- dataset_result$registry
  dataset_heatmap_metrics <- lapply(dataset_result$evaluated, function(x) {
    rows <- x$scores[x$scores$evaluation_id == dataset_result$primary_evaluation, ]
    data.frame(value = rows$value, score = ifelse(rows$metric == "anosim_score", "ANOSIM", rows$metric))
  })
  dataset_metrics <- list()
  dataset_joint <- list()
  dataset_decomposition <- list()
  for (method in selected_methods) {
    method_result <- dataset_result$methods[[method]]
    metric <- make_batch_metric_table(
      dataset = dataset,
      method = method,
      metadata = dataset_result$metadata,
      candidate_registry = registry,
      dist_mat = method_result$dist_mat,
      artifact_path = method_result$path,
      permutations = n_permutations,
      parallel = parallel_cores,
      permanova_permutations = permanova_permutations,
      precomputed_anosim = dataset_heatmap_metrics[[method]]$value[
        dataset_heatmap_metrics[[method]]$score == "ANOSIM"
      ]
    )
    metric_index <- metric_index + 1L
    metric_tables[[metric_index]] <- metric
    dataset_metrics[[method]] <- metric

    joint <- compute_batch_joint_permanova(
      method_result$dist_mat,
      dataset_result$metadata,
      ds_registry,
      permutations = permanova_permutations,
      parallel = parallel_cores
    )
    joint_table <- make_batch_joint_table(dataset, method, joint, method_result$path)
    joint_index <- joint_index + 1L
    joint_tables[[joint_index]] <- joint_table
    dataset_joint[[method]] <- joint_table

    if (is.null(joint$decomposition)) {
      decomposition <- data.frame(
        component = c("Unique Biological", "Unique Technical", "Shared / Confounded", "Residual / Unexplained"),
        r2 = NA_real_,
        status = joint$status,
        warning = joint$warning,
        n_samples = as.integer(joint$n_samples),
        full_model_r2 = NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      decomposition <- joint$decomposition
    }
    decomposition$dataset <- dataset
    decomposition$method <- method
    decomposition$method_label <- unname(method_label_map_main[[method]])
    decomposition$artifact_path <- method_result$path
    decomposition_index <- decomposition_index + 1L
    decomposition_tables[[decomposition_index]] <- decomposition
    dataset_decomposition[[method]] <- decomposition
  }


  metric_data <- do.call(rbind, dataset_metrics)
  metric_data$method_label <- factor(metric_data$method_label, levels = method_labels)
  .save_plot(
    .metric_plot(
      metric_data,
      "anosim_statistic",
      "anosim_status",
      paste0(dataset, " — ANOSIM by metadata covariate"),
      "ANOSIM statistic"
    ),
    file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_anosim.pdf")),
    width = 14,
    height = 7
  )
  .save_plot(
    .metric_plot(
      metric_data,
      "univariate_r2",
      "univariate_status",
      paste0(dataset, " — univariate PERMANOVA"),
      "Marginal R²"
    ),
    file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_permanova_univariate.pdf")),
    width = 14,
    height = 7
  )
  .save_plot(
    .metric_plot(
      metric_data,
      "biology_informed_r2",
      "biology_informed_status",
      paste0(dataset, " — biology-informed PERMANOVA"),
      "Candidate marginal R² after primary biology",
      exclude_primary = TRUE
    ),
    file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_permanova_bio_informed.pdf")),
    width = 14,
    height = 7
  )

  joint_data <- do.call(rbind, dataset_joint)
  joint_data$method_label <- factor(joint_data$method_label, levels = method_labels)
  joint_data$plot_candidate <- ifelse(
    joint_data$status == "ESTIMABLE" & !is.na(joint_data$joint_model_term),
    joint_data$joint_model_term,
    joint_data$candidate
  )
  joint_data$candidate <- joint_data$plot_candidate
  joint_data$candidate_class <- ifelse(
    joint_data$status == "ESTIMABLE" & !is.na(joint_data$joint_model_class),
    joint_data$joint_model_class,
    joint_data$candidate_class
  )
  design_status <- unique(joint_data$joint_design_status)
  design_title <- if (length(design_status) == 1L && design_status == "ESTIMABLE_REDUCED") {
    "joint PERMANOVA candidate terms (reduced estimable design)"
  } else {
    "joint PERMANOVA candidate terms"
  }
  upper <- .metric_plot(
    joint_data,
    "r2",
    "status",
    paste0(dataset, " — ", design_title),
    "Reduced-model marginal R²"
  )
  decomposition_data <- do.call(rbind, dataset_decomposition)
  decomposition_data$method_label <- factor(decomposition_data$method_label, levels = method_labels)
  decomposition_data <- decomposition_data[decomposition_data$status %in% c("ESTIMABLE", "ESTIMABLE_REDUCED") & is.finite(decomposition_data$r2), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(decomposition_data) == 0L) {
    lower <- .blank_plot(
      paste0(dataset, " — global decomposition"),
      "No estimable reduced joint design"
    )
  } else {
    lower <- ggplot(decomposition_data, aes(x = method_label, y = r2, fill = component)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste0(dataset, " — global decomposition"), x = NULL, y = "R² component", fill = NULL) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  }
  joint_panel <- upper / lower + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1))
  .save_plot(
    joint_panel,
    file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_permanova_joint.pdf")),
    width = 14,
    height = 11
  )

  nmi <- compute_batch_nmi(dataset_result$metadata, ds_registry)
  nmi_table <- make_batch_nmi_table(dataset, nmi, ds_registry)
  nmi_index <- nmi_index + 1L
  nmi_tables[[nmi_index]] <- nmi_table
  .save_plot(
    plot_batch_nmi_heatmap(nmi, dataset),
    file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_nmi.pdf")),
    width = 11,
    height = 9
  )
  rm(dataset_result)
}
scores <- do.call(rbind, metric_tables)
scores$.row_order <- seq_len(nrow(scores))
joint_scores <- do.call(rbind, joint_tables)
join_columns <- c(
  "dataset", "method", "candidate", "r2", "pseudo_f", "p_value",
  "p_adjusted_holm", "status", "warning", "reduction_status",
  "reduction_warning", "joint_model_term", "joint_model_class",
  "joint_reduction_group", "joint_design_status", "joint_design_warning",
  "n_samples", "full_model_r2"
)
joint_scores <- joint_scores[, join_columns, drop = FALSE]
colnames(joint_scores)[match(
  c("r2", "pseudo_f", "p_value", "p_adjusted_holm", "status", "warning", "n_samples"),
  colnames(joint_scores)
)] <- c(
  "joint_r2", "joint_pseudo_f", "joint_p_value", "joint_p_adjusted_holm",
  "joint_status", "joint_warning", "joint_n_samples"
)
scores <- merge(scores, joint_scores, by = c("dataset", "method", "candidate"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
scores <- scores[order(scores$.row_order), , drop = FALSE]
scores$.row_order <- NULL
row.names(scores) <- NULL

decomposition <- do.call(rbind, decomposition_tables)
nmi <- do.call(rbind, nmi_tables)
write_batch_release_artifact(scores, file.path(analysis_output_root, "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_scores.csv"), csv = TRUE)
write_batch_release_artifact(decomposition, file.path(analysis_output_root, "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_decomposition.csv"), csv = TRUE)
write_batch_release_artifact(nmi, file.path(analysis_output_root, "batch_effect_uncorrected_final_nmi.csv"), csv = TRUE)
```

Maintained dataset filenames include `_anosim.pdf`, `_permanova_univariate.pdf`,
`_permanova_bio_informed.pdf`, `_permanova_joint.pdf` and `_nmi.pdf`. Source bundles
are immutable. Derived tables and their checksum sidecars live under the explicit
release ID; production plots are generated only after its release control is approved.
